openThreads.text: Upcoming Xi–Trump meeting complicates secondary-sanctions action against Chinese banks. Updated Aug 27: Trump coy in the Oval Office — 'Who said I'm not? You don't know if I'm doing it' — but no major Chinese financial institution has been listed. Updated Aug 30: Bessent pushed back on China-bank critics — the blockade has already curbed most of China's Iran oil purchases and Iranian oil in floating storage is dwindling ('Problem solved'); still no Chinese institution listed, and the new weekly bank-first sanctions cadence keeps the question live.
Bessent predicts a 'broad array' of countries follows UAE in cutting trade ties — watch for named countries.
Iran threatened to halt all oil exports in response to the sanctions campaign.

Tanker strikes in the strait: week's third commercial-vessel strike — Saturday Aug 29 an unknown projectile hit a tanker 12nm north of al-Khasab, Oman (no injuries or environmental damage; UKMTO warning issued late Sunday — delayed reporting; no attribution, no Iranian claim or denial). Prior items: Monday's Ash Shishah vessel name still unconfirmed (UKMTO 120-26, Liberian-flagged per Fox); Kuwaiti-connected tanker's tow/salvage status unchanged; Kuwait separately told the IMO a KPC supertanker was struck earlier in August. UKMTO Aug 29: strait risk SEVERE, traffic 'significantly reduced,' operators favouring the Northern route, continuing IRGC harassment (drone overflights, targeted surveillance of merchant vessels, radio transmissions). Watch attribution, tow/salvage status, and UKMTO follow-ups. Updated Aug 30: UKMTO WARNING 122-26 (issued Sunday, 4:22 PM) formalizes the Saturday strike — 'unknown projectile' while inbound 12nm north of Khasab, no casualties or environmental impact, investigation underway, third UKMTO-reported attack in a week; still no attribution and no tow/salvage update.

Pakistan mediation round one (Munir's Tehran visit) closed without visible outcome. Updated Aug 29: Gharibabadi framed the weekend's Qatari and Pakistani visits as aimed at determining whether the parties can return to implementing the Islamabad MoU's commitments; Qatar remains the visible mediation channel — watch for a second round, a concrete next step, or US engagement on the MoU.

Iran–Oman Hormuz corridor — first 'reached' claim: Gharibabadi said Aug 29 Iran and Oman have reached an understanding over the strait, but it 'will not be implemented until the United States fulfills its commitments under the Islamabad MoU'; 'the Strait of Hormuz remains closed, and any vessel passing through the strait does so in coordination with Iran'; Tehran will continue 'defensive measures' and is 'prepared for any scenario.' Pezeshkian separately urged reviving the lapsed June 17 MoU (~90M barrels sold under it). Still unresolved: the transit-fee dispute, the 30–60-day permanent-scheme negotiation, Rezaei's 'designated central channel' conditional on the US first meeting Iran's conditions, and White House non-engagement — watch for implementation, US reaction, IMO notification, and corridor usage data.
Pezeshkian–Putin meeting at SCO Bishkek (Sept 1) incl. a reported $25B nuclear-plants MOU — watch for outcomes.
NBC intel-damage report (≥20 US government sites in 8 countries, 2,000+ projectiles, CIA station Riyadh hit, billions in repairs) — watch for official confirmation/denial or the original NBC filing.

Southern-route friction: no new enforcement incident Aug 27; Cooper reports mines cleared, international lanes open, 'momentum building' (~1,500 vessels assisted, ~750M barrels protected) while Kpler counted only 5 transits vs traders' ~7–8M bpd exiting (dark/shuttle trade gap); prior items — Iranian warship deterring HAANA from the southern 'Oman corridor', Saudi STS supertankers off Oman, Trump's 'immediately and systematically destroyed' warning to new mine-layers — remain watch items; track enforcement incidents and corridor usage. Updated Aug 30: Kpler counted 5 visible transits/day over the weekend (Friday 14 incl. a dark VLCC laden with 2M bbl Qatari crude); TankerTrackers averaged ~6.7M bpd crude passing the blockade line over the past 7 days (single tracker, AIS + satellite); the Larak strike followed US intel that the IRGC was preparing to fire mine-carrying rockets into the strait, days after CENTCOM's mine clearance; INTERTANKO 'not sufficient' warning lands Sep 1.

Rezaei compiling Iran's formal conditions list for reopening Hormuz: reportedly up to $300B compensation for wartime damages, removal of US sanctions, ~$100B frozen assets released, end to the regional war, lifting of the naval blockade (exact sums single-outlet via Crypto Briefing; wires confirm the list itself) — watch for the formal list, US response, and whether the 'designated central channel' opens.

DOJ reviving maritime prize courts to condemn and sell vessels/cargo seized enforcing the blockade, proceeds to Treasury (Bloomberg via Fox Business; SD Tex US Attorney Reitz) — watch for the first condemnation filings and expected owner legal challenges.

FinCEN's Banque Misr UAE special measure is an NPRM (UAE-branch scope only; Egyptian parent untouched). Updated Aug 29: Banque Misr says it is reviewing the notice 'with utmost seriousness and attention' while its UAE branches keep serving customers; Egypt's central bank says it and the foreign ministry are in contact with US officials, noting the measure is limited to Banque Misr UAE's USD transactions with correspondent banks. Forbes (Aug 30, post-window): Federal Register publication had not yet appeared — the 30-day comment clock had not started. Watch for Federal Register publication, finalization, and further Egyptian/UAE central-bank responses to the proposed correspondent-account cutoff.

US–Venezuela oil deal implementation: 17 fields, >65B barrels in associated reserves, 55% effective US output share, 100-year rights, ~$100B promised private investment — watch SPR replenishment purchases, the reported Venezuela OPEC exit, and legal/constitutional challenges (Democrats opposed). Updated Aug 30: Trump said SPR 'topping out' with oil secured under the deal 'will begin shortly' — 'Gift from Venezuela to the People of the United States'; reserve ~290M bbl as of Aug 21 (near 44-year low, fell ~3.1M bbl the prior week); delivery timing and pump relief unclear.

US–Iran exchange follow-up: post-window Monday quotes — Trump 'We're going to hit them hard… There will be a response'; a senior Iranian source called the overnight exchange a 'limited and contained confrontation'. Watch for US follow-up strikes inside Iran: if more come, NIGHT 02+ counts; if none, the no-strikes streak rebuilds from 0.
Retaliation-wave scope: post-window Monday reporting (The Hill, IJR) says Iran's attacks widened beyond Jordan to the UAE — watch scope, casualties, and US/Jordan/UAE responses.
IRGC supertanker-mines claim in the southern strait (Iranian state TV; US military denied) — timing unclear, likely overnight Sun→Mon; watch for vessel name, UKMTO confirmation, and US detail.

Weekly secondary-sanctions cadence: Bessent — 'You're going to see a lot more of these every week', banks first, with possible escalation to cutting an institution off entirely from the dollar system ('There can be no leakage'); first package of the new rhythm expected week of Aug 31; G20 Asheville finance meeting Aug 31–Sep 1.
Larak casualty figures — 3 killed per Tasnim, two IRGC Navy per Nournews — Iranian-side only; watch for independent tolls or official confirmation.
